summary: Applies simulated lens distortion for MoSys camera tracking workflows using channel data from a connected MoSys CHOP.
common_gotchas: Official docs mark MoSys TOP as TouchDesigner Pro only.
Requires a MoSys CHOP with valid camera-tracking channel data; the TOP is not a standalone tracking receiver.
Input texture quality and resolution affect the final distorted render because the TOP warps image content.
Use it as part of a camera-tracking/render-composite pipeline, not as a generic image effect.
key_concepts: Works with MoSys camera tracking systems for virtual-production lens distortion.
Uses channel data from a connected MoSys CHOP to calculate simulated lens distortion.
Warps the input TOP as part of a camera-tracking/render-composite pipeline.
Official docs mark the operator as available only in TouchDesigner Pro.
